title: Caleb Williams: We'll be more entertaining throughout the whole game this year

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Caleb Williams: We'll be more entertaining throughout the whole game this year
sources.description: The Bears had a knack for saving their best work for the latest portions of games while winning the NFC North and advancing to the divisional round of the playoffs last year, but quarterback Caleb Williams isn't looking for a repeat of that in 2026.
